=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py:455 versus 462-464 and 471-474 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_segment_credentials()` does not capture a hyphen-prefixed value supplied as a separate argument to a long credential flag; the credential value is never masked and is posted verbatim.
  WHY: A command such as `tool --password -foo1234` has its value filtered out, while the short-flag branch explicitly handles values beginning with `-`.
- tests/test_permission_prompts.py:269+, 311+, 348+ | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: No test exercises a long credential flag whose separate-word value starts with `-`.
  WHY: CI does not catch the credential-masking defect, and a regression after a fix would pass the full test suite silently.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: G1 plan statement: "the value of every credential-bearing flag … every long flag whose name names a credential, such as `--user`, `--password`, `--token`, `--cookie`, `--auth`, `--api-key`, but not `--author` … become `***`". G2: "Fail closed: when the command cannot be parsed, or a value to mask does not occur verbatim in the posted text, or is shorter than 4 characters, the command text is withheld". The phase 1 done condition: "the issue's exploit command and a Basic-auth header leave no credential in the issue body, immediate block, or shape."
  Expected change site: `_segment_credentials` long-flag branch in `workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py` (and the byte-identical `.claude/` copy committed by 258e18f). Should consume the next word as the credential value when `_CREDENTIAL_LONG_FLAG_RE` matches and the value is supplied as a separate argument, regardless of whether that next word starts with `-`, matching the documented contract of the short-flag branch. `tests/test_permission_prompts.py` should gain at least one positive case (long flag + hyphen-prefixed value masked in `test_example_masks_credentials`) and one withheld case (hyphen-prefixed value that does not occur verbatim, exercising G2 fail-closed for the long-flag branch).
  Evidence of absence: Line 455 filters `following` to `None` when the next word starts with `-`, so lines 462-464 can never consume a hyphen-prefixed value for a long flag. The short-flag branch (lines 471-474) has no such filter and its comment explicitly states the opposite intent. The new test additions cover every other credential-flag family and value shape, but no test parametrizes a long flag with a hyphen-prefixed separate-word value. The plan deviation log in `docs/implement-plan/issue-5124-mask-credentials-in-prompt-reports.md` does not mention this case.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  PROBLEM: The long-flag branch has asymmetric filtering, matching the issue in `.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py`.
  WHY: Credentials starting with a hyphen are not captured and masked, so they are leaked.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Mask credential-bearing flags, as stated in G1: "the value of every credential-bearing flag [...] become `***`".
  Expected change site: `_segment_credentials` long-flag branch in `.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py` and `workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py`, with accompanying tests in `tests/test_permission_prompts.py`.
  Evidence of absence: The `_segment_credentials` logic (both files) explicitly filters out values starting with a hyphen in the long-flag branch (lines 455-464), leading to unmasked credentials in those cases. `tests/test_permission_prompts.py` lacks a positive test case exercising a long credential flag whose separate-word value starts with a hyphen.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py:455 and 462-464 (also lines 444-475 block); same code at the twin path `workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py` | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The long-flag branch captures `following` only when the next word does not start with `-`, so a hyphen-prefixed separate-word value to a long credential flag is never added to the credential set or masked.
  WHY: Fallback redaction does not cover this shape, so the original credential is posted verbatim to the issue body, issue title, immediate block, comment body, and shape fallback.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: G1 plan statement — "the value of every credential-bearing flag (`-u`/`-U`/`-b`/`-E` for curl, `-p` for the mysql family and `sshpass`, `-a` for httpie and `redis-cli`, `-p` for `docker`/`podman login`, and every long flag whose name names a credential, such as `--user`, `--password`, `--token`, `--cookie`, `--auth`, `--api-key`, but not `--author`) … become `***`"; G2 fail-closed — "when the command cannot be parsed, or a value to mask does not occur verbatim in the posted text, or is shorter than 4 characters, the command text is withheld"; done condition — "the issue's exploit command and a Basic-auth header leave no credential in the issue body, immediate block, or shape."
  Expected change site: `_segment_credentials()` long-flag branch in both `.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py` and `workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py`, paired with positive tests in `tests/test_permission_prompts.py` (under the `_bash(command)` parametrization used by `test_example_masks_credentials`, plus a withheld case under `test_example_is_withheld_when_masking_cannot_be_exact`, and a shape case under `test_shape_never_carries_raw_credentials`) covering a long credential flag with a hyphen-prefixed separate-word value (e.g. `tool --password -foo1234`).
  Evidence of absence: The new `test_example_masks_credentials` parametrize block (`tests/test_permission_prompts.py:269+`) covers every other long-flag form (space-separated, `=`-separated, attached short flag, header), but no entry parametrizes a long flag with a hyphen-prefixed separate-word value; `test_example_is_withheld_when_masking_cannot_be_exact` (line 311+) does not exercise the same case for the fail-closed path; `test_shape_never_carries_raw_credentials` (line 348+) covers attached short flags and headers but not long flags with hyphen-prefixed values. The plan deviation log in `docs/implement-plan/issue-5124-mask-credentials-in-prompt-reports.md` lists only `docker login` (`-u` is a username), the cluster boolean letter rule, and `auth` excludes `author` — no documented exception for long flags whose separate-word value starts with `-`. The implementation source diff still has the asymmetric `following` filter on the long-flag branch only, so the missing case is a real coverage gap, not a documented intentional carve-out.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
